thread:
Samir Patel: hey team, quick intro — i'm Samir, started today on Platform. Trying to follow the quickstart to spin up a tiny test in europe-west1 but running into access errors when listing VMs. who should i bug for region/billing perms? :wave:

Samir Patel: gcloud output:```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.list) PERMISSION_DENIED: User does not have permission to list instances on project redwood-eu-sandbox
```

kelly_it: welcome Samir! :tada: did you get added to the SSO groups during onboarding? sometimes new hires only get the base `engineering` group which lacks infra/project roles.

Samir Patel: i just got the security onboarding email and completed the access checklist. it only mentioned "engineering" group.

noah_cloudeng: hi Samir — for EU dev projects you need `roles/viewer` on the project and `roles/compute.viewer` specifically to list/describe instances. For billing visibility we usually add people to the `billing-viewers` group or grant `billing.viewer` on the billing account.

Samir Patel: ah ok. i also opened the AWS console to check a cross-cloud script and my account shows AccessDenied for the billing dashboard. kind of confusing to see both issues at once.

kelly_it: that sounds like SSO group propagation + billing link missing. i've opened ticket ONB-211 to add you to `infra-eu` and `billing-viewers`. infra-bot will track it.

infra-bot: Ticket ONB-211 created by kelly_it for user Samir Patel — "Add infra-eu SSO + billing viewer". Priority: P3. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-211

noah_cloudeng: while IT sorts the SSO group, i can grant a short-lived `compute.viewer` role on redwood-eu-sandbox so you can finish the quickstart. i'll attach the policy change here when done.

noah_cloudeng: granted `roles/compute.viewer` on project redwood-eu-sandbox to samir.patel@redwood.com for 2 hours.

Samir Patel: thanks — listing instances works now and i can SSH into the tiny vm. that unblocks me for the tutorial. :raised_hands:

Samir Patel: any tips for verifying billing access once the group is added?

kelly_it: after you're added to billing-viewers, you should be able to see the billing account in the GCP console under Billing -> Billing accounts for your org. On AWS the billing console requires either org-level access or explicit linking to the team billing account; you'll see the account id if it's linked. If you still see AccessDenied paste a screenshot and we'll escalate.

Samir Patel: got it. one small note for the onboarding doc: the quickstart didn't mention waiting ~10m for group sync or what CLI commands to run to check membership. might save future folks some time.

kelly_it: good feedback, i'll add a line: "Confirm membership in infra-eu or infra-admins; if not present request SSO group add. Allow 10-15m for propagation. Verify with `gcloud projects get-iam-policy <project> --filter=bindings.members:<your-email>`"

Samir Patel: perfect — thanks everyone for the fast help. excited to be here!

kelly_it: welcome again, Samir. ping here or #eng-infra if anything else pops up.
